customers_say: Customers praise the door lock's quality and features, noting its premium build and clean appearance. The installation process receives mixed feedback from customers.

reviews.author: pratik raj
reviews.title: Superb product and built quality
reviews.body: nice lock with great 2 way talk, camera and lurker alarm. I am happy with the product. Customer care of urban company sucks. That is only negative thing that i saw

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Excellent Product, Delayed Installation
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ The lock looks premium, has great features, and the installation by Prakaash was excellent. He was professional, helpful, and explained everything clearly. The only thing was the installation process. I had to raise a support ticket and follow up manually, and the installation was completed about a week later. Apart from that, everything went smoothly. Overall, a great product with a good first impression.

reviews.author: Deepak S.
reviews.title: Great Lock. Locked Behind Poor Service.
reviews.body: The lock is smart. The installation process... not so much. The lock itself deserves applause. It looks premium, feels sturdy, and performs exactly as you'd expect from a product in this price range. Face unlock is quick, operation is smooth, and the overall build quality is impressive. No complaints about the hardware. Unfortunately, buying a smart lock also means buying the installation experience—and that's where things went downhill. reviews.author: Suman Kumar Ghosh
reviews.title: Great lock with awesome built and features but not so great Installation service
reviews.body: First of all, I have no complaints about the lock itself—its build quality and features are excellent, and I believe it is one of the best available in the market. However, there was a mismatch between the installation requirements mentioned in the product manual and the actual installation process. The booklet states that installation is supported on doors with a thickness of 30 mm, but the technician informed me that a minimum thickness of 35 mm is required.
